super-memori v3.4.9

- Updates the skill operating contract to clarify that --mode semantic and --mode hybrid are CLI-compatible but not for normal weak-model use in v3.x; only --mode auto, exact, recent, and learning are fully supported for automation.
- Improves instructions for weak-model routing and clarifies the handling of exit code 1 (no results found), including new cautions to append freshness notes from warnings[] when present.
- Adds clearer distinctions on when and how to state degradation versus clean failure, especially in degraded or partially-stale index states.
- Documents compatibility/maintenance-only status for direct semantic/hybrid retrieval in this release.
- Adds a new pattern-report.json in the reports directory.
- General wording and contract improvements across documentation and references.
